description: Rețea transport energie electrică is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANCPI. The data set represents the electricity transmission network. It includes the transport energy objectives, i.e. the NCTEE’s lines, stations, energy, administrative and storage constructions for integrated pollution control. The dataset was collected by field measurements. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity transmission network" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
